info.title: Kiwi.com API
info.description:
Search and compare flights on Kiwi.com — itineraries with live prices, airlines, routes and departure/arrival times, plus location and route discovery.

Every request needs an API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys. A successful request uses one credit, unless its operation says more (`x-credits`). That price covers 200 rows (or the operation's `x-credits-rows`); a request that returns more pays it again for each further page of that many rows. The `x-maviapi-credits` response header says what a request cost.

Endpoint reference with live examples: https://maviapi.com/apis/kiwi

get.description: Cheapest flight to every destination city from a place, like the site's 'anywhere' search: one row per city with price, airport and times. Narrow by country, region or continent, dates, price and stops; expand attaches full itineraries.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Origin. Codes first: a 3-letter code is an airport (else a metro city code such as LON), an upper-case 2-letter code a country (else a continent such as EU). Then a name of any place type (city, airport, subdivision, country, region, continent), case and accent insensitive, or a search id from /places-v2 (e.g. 'Airport:CRL', 'Country:TR'). An unclear or unknown value answers 400 with candidates.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional broad scope for the destinations: a country, subdivision, region or continent (code, name or search id, same rules as from). Omit or 'anywhere' for every destination.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start of the departure date window, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days from today.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: End of the departure date window, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Defaults to date_from (a single day).

parameters.name: return_from
parameters.description: Start of the return date window, YYYY-MM-DD. Set it for a round trip; omit for one-way.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: End of the return date window, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Defaults to return_from.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price per destination, in `currency`.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price per destination, in `currency`.

parameters.name: max_stops
parameters.description: Most stops per leg (0 = direct only). Omit for any.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adult passengers (1-9).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Child passengers (0-8).

parameters.name: infants
parameters.description: Infant passengers (at most one per adult).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Which flight represents each city and the order of the cities: PRICE = cheapest first, POPULARITY = the site's popular destinations first (the set differs a little per sort).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Price currency (3-letter ISO code); min_price and max_price use it too.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Also attach the top 3 itineraries (segments, airlines, booking link) for the destinations ranked 1 to N (on whichever page they fall). 0 = none.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Destinations per page (max 1000). Every reachable city is returned, see pagination.total.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset over every destination city.

available.description: Whether the same flights are still on sale for these passengers.

status.description: available: on sale now; unavailable: the live search no longer sells these flights; departed: the first flight has left (no search is made).

price.description: The current total price for these passengers; null when unavailable.

quoted_price.description: The price carried in the id: what the original search quoted, in its own currency and for its own passengers.

price_changed.description: Whether price.amount differs from quoted_price (meaningful with the original search's currency and passengers); null when unavailable.

price_change.description: price.amount minus quoted_price; null when unavailable.

booking_url.description: A fresh kiwi.com booking link for these flights, passengers and currency; null when unavailable.

get.description: Flight search with date windows plus several origins and destinations (from=BRU,CRL), local departure and arrival time windows, and every itinerary the search has, paged by cursor, with total_estimate. Each itinerary names the origin and destination it matched and when its price expires.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Origin: one place or a comma list of up to 3 (BRU,CRL or LON,STN). Each item follows the /search-v2 rules: a 3-letter code is an airport (else a metro city code such as LON), an upper-case 2-letter code a country (else a continent), then a name of any place type, case and accent insensitive, or a search id from /places-v2 ('Airport:CRL'). Names that contain a comma need their search id. An unclear item answers 400 with candidates.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Destination: one place or a comma list of up to 3, same rules as from, or 'anywhere' alone for every destination.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start of the departure date window, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days from today.

maviapiKey.description: Your maviapi API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Row fields to keep in a list answer, comma separated (at most 50). A dot reaches into an object, or into each object of an array (venue.city). A name no row has is a 400 that lists the fields a row has.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: pagination.next_cursor of the previous page, sent with the same other params: the next page of the same stored copy of the list, so a walk never skips or repeats a row when the cache refreshes or the site reorders. A cursor for other params is 400 invalid_cursor; a copy that is gone is 410 cursor_expired (start again without cursor).

MaxAge.name: max_age
MaxAge.description: Serve a stored answer only when it was read at most this many seconds ago (0 to 86400); older, the site is read again. 0 is refresh=true. Any other value is 400 invalid_max_age.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed later without any change. When true, wait the seconds in `Retry-After` (if sent) first.

FetchedAt.description: When this data was read from the site (ISO 8601, UTC). Also in the x-maviapi-fetched-at header.

Age.description: Seconds since fetched_at: 0 for a fresh read, more for a stored answer. Also in the Age header.

NextCursor.description: Send as `cursor`, with the same other params, for the next page of the same copy of the list; null on the last page.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or cannot be used.

Unauthorized.description: No API key was sent, or the key is invalid or revoked (`missing_api_key`, `invalid_api_key`).
